To this day, I cannot make any money transfers, pay bills, or even change or modify basic options within the app. Most buttons and options are completely non-responsive; for example, I cannot select the "transfer reason" or change the card I want to pay bills from, not to mention a long list of other technical issues.
It is completely unprofessional to discontinue the old app and force customers to switch to the new one without testing it thoroughly and ensuring it works efficiently. What happened has disrupted customers' interests and caused a major decline in service quality. I hope these disastrous issues are fixed immediately, or that the option to revert to the old app is provided until the bugs are resolved.

title: About the Latest Update of the APP
body:
The previous version of the ADCB app was much better than the current update. After the latest update, the app feels slower, less responsive, and several useful options seem to be missing or harder to find.

Normally, app updates are meant to improve speed, convenience, and the overall user experience. Unfortunately, this update has done the opposite. Tasks that were quick and easy before now take longer, and the app doesn’t feel as smooth or consistent as it used to.

I hope the ADCB team listens to customer feedback and brings back the speed, simplicity, and functionality that the previous version offered. Please consider fixing these issues in the next update and make the app faster and more user-friendly again.

body:
I am extremely disappointed with the ADCB deposit machine at Al Ain Mall. This has happened to me and several of my colleagues multiple times: whenever we need to deposit money, the machine is either out of service or becomes jammed after accepting our cash.

The most frustrating part is when the machine takes the money but fails to process the transaction. Customers are then left waiting anxiously, wondering whether their hard-earned money is safe. Every time I contact customer service, I receive the same response—to wait 48 hours while a concern is raised. There is never any immediate reassurance or guarantee that the issue will be resolved without complications.

While the ADCB app has improved over time, the deposit machines continue to be unreliable. It is difficult to understand why such a common problem keeps occurring without a permanent solution. Unfortunately, the only thing that seems to work consistently is the monthly charges and fees being deducted from customers’ accounts.

A bank should provide reliable banking services and peace of mind, not unnecessary stress every time customers need to make a simple cash deposit. I sincerely hope ADCB takes this issue seriously and improves the reliability of its machines, especially at Al Ain Mall.
author: nairajoy

reply.body:
We understand your frustration. While some features within the Mobile Banking app were affected, the issue extended beyond the app itself and was not caused by it. In the meantime, you can continue to access and manage your accounts through the ADCB Internet Banking portal by visiting adcb.com/login, and we recommend using a desktop browser for the best experience. 
K.A

title: Smooth interface, but payment sync issues!
body:
The new application looks very good, the interface is smooth, and the overall user experience is nice. However, there are serious data synchronization issues. Even after paying my credit card bill, it still shows the full pending amount instead of updating. If a partial payment is made, it should show the remaining balance; if paid in full, it should show a zero balance.
Since the old application is no longer working, please fix this real-time data update issue as soon as possible. Once this bug is resolved, this will definitely be a 5-star application!

Kindly investigate this issue as soon as possible and let me know the current status of my transaction. If the transfer could not be completed, please process the refund to my bank account immediately.

title: The new adcb app is a downgrade
body:
The new ADCB app has been unusable for me for over a week. Instead of improving the user experience, it has made basic banking impossible. I can’t even open the app to check my account.

A major app redesign should have been fully tested and stable before being rolled out to customers. Banking apps need to be reliable, especially when people depend on them to access their money.

I hope ADCB resolves these issues as soon as possible because the previous app was far more dependable.

title: Please bring the old app back
body:
By far the laggiest banking application I have seen in my life. Since I started using ADCB 5 years ago, I never had a single problem with the old application. It was easy and clean, and, most importantly, IT WAS WORKING.
Since the new application launched, I stopped getting message notifications about my balance. To see the balance, I have to log in into the app. Updating the notification preferences is not possible because it’s still under development. AI features not working. To use the website I need to log in with some unclear credentials. To reset the password I need the card details that are… inside the app. And the app has not been working for the past week. 
Please drop the pursuit of AI that is clearly not working and let us use the old app.

title: Unacceptable Banking App Experience
body:
It’s been over a week, and I’m still unable to send money or use many of the app’s essential features. This has affected my monthly payments and caused significant inconvenience. Even my ADCB Apple Wallet wasn’t working despite having sufficient funds in my account.

The previous version of the app was much better and far more user-friendly. Before releasing a major update, please ensure it is thoroughly tested instead of forcing users to install a version that isn’t functioning properly.

This is a critical banking app that people rely on every day. While I understand occasional server maintenance, having online banking show “under maintenance” for four consecutive days is unacceptable. One day of maintenance is understandable, but prolonged outages like this are highly disruptive and not what customers expect from a banking service.
author: Guddydev

title: App keeps crashing
body:
The app keeps crashing. Ever since I migrated to the new version, I’ve struggled to access my account. Even when I do manage to log in, it doesn’t take long before the app stops working again.

The purpose of releasing a new app should be to improve accessibility and make banking easier, but unfortunately this update has had the opposite effect. I can barely make payments, and the overall user experience feels overwhelming.

If possible, please allow customers to continue using the old platform alongside the new one until these issues are resolved. At the very least, it would give us a reliable backup.

The website is also unreliable, so the entire digital banking experience feels broken. At this point, the only consistently functional service seems to be the ATMs. This is especially frustrating and inconvenient when you have bills that need to be paid on time.
author: Fro_sty

reply.body:
Hi, we recognize the frustration caused by the recent service disruption. While some app services were impacted, the issue was not caused by the new app itself. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Unhappy experience
body:
A banking service interruption for a day or two may be understandable, but having disruptions continue for nearly a week is unacceptable. It shows a lack of preparedness and raises concerns about how much the bank values its customers.

I am very disappointed with the repeated service interruptions over the past few weeks. Customers rely on their bank for essential transactions such as salary, rent, and bill payments, and prolonged outages cause unnecessary stress and inconvenience.

I hope ADCB takes this seriously, improves its systems, and ensures such extended disruptions do not happen again.

title: Very Disappointing Banking Experience…
body:
I’ve been facing issues with the ADCB app for a long time, and it’s getting worse. For the last 3 days, I haven’t been able to use the app because it keeps showing error alerts. I urgently need to send money to my home country, but every transaction fails.

This isn’t the first time. In the past, my Fixed Deposit balance has sometimes disappeared from the dashboard, even though the money was invested. There have also been times when the app wouldn’t open at all, or Face ID wouldn’t work. These recurring issues make it very difficult to trust the app.

To make things worse, I’ve called customer care several times, but no one answers. There is no proper support when customers need urgent help.

The FD returns are also quite low compared to my expectations. ADCB is a well-known bank, but my experience has been disappointing due to the frequent technical issues and lack of customer support.

I hope ADCB fixes these problems soon because customers expect a reliable banking app, especially when dealing with their money.

Thank you for your patience and understanding during this time.

title: App Fails After Update – No Customer Support While On Vacation⁠
body:

title: Unusable After Update — Can’t Even Transfer Funds
body:
I don't usually post reviews, but this new app from ADCB has left me no choice.

Since updating, I've had major issues:

- **Slow login and slow loading** throughout the app — checking credit card details or other account info now takes far longer than before.

- **Beneficiaries not showing up**, which means I can't transfer money to my family or friends.

- **"Unauthorized access" errors** when trying to view my beneficiary list, even while logged in.

The previous version of the app was fast, responsive, and reliable. This new version feels like a major downgrade — a modern UI paired with buggy functionality and half-baked AI features that get in the way of basic banking.

I've been an ADCB customer for over 6 years and have watched the app improve over time. It's disappointing to see it take such a step back, especially since these aren't minor glitches — customers can't even complete a basic funds transfer.

ADCB should not have made this update mandatory before thoroughly testing it. I'd urge the team to restore the old app's functionality until these issues are properly fixed.

If I could give zero stars, I would.

title: Welcome marketing gimmicks, goodbye usability. ADCB has gone backwards.
body:
This app is a textbook example of what happens when executive prioritize marketing over user experience. 

What is it with a massive unintuitive interactive cards? I can now only see two or three valuable pieces of information on my home screen whereas the old app gave me immediate visibility over multiple critical data points.

The new agent Chatbot is very useless a massive waste of screen real estate with incredibly poor capabilities. Furthermore, why does it not require multiple clicks just to view all my accounts? This used to be the default view, but now I have to actively navigate to it only to be greeted by a horrible UI layout.

Forcing the decommissioning of the old App was a cynical MOVE because management knew the majority of users would have immediately rolled back to it. This isn’t a Banking app anymore, it feels like a forced sales platform.

First of all, where is the consolidated monthly cash flow feature for money buddy? That was arguably the single best mobile Banking feature ADCB had over every other Bank in the region and you completely stripped it out.

title: Slow ! Bad performance
body:
This app is really slow! It lags alot. It took ages to switch between screens. 

How come with all the technology access that we have today ADCB release such an slow performance app! 

Why you don’t perform any type of load / performance testing before releasing it and advertising about it accross the region. 

The UI performance is not good at all along the APIs that app communite with are very slow. Have you consider some caching, tested latency and performance?

Why do i need to wait a couple of seconds till i see a service catalog thay has zero customer information “static menu”?

Why do i need to wait a 20s to wait for my cards to show up? And another 30 second to reveal the card information? 

Speaking about UX i can find loads of issues as well.

Please ADCB team take this review as positive feedback where you can enhance your customer experience across your digital channels and here I’m talking specifically about the app.

title: Please fix
body:
Very disappointing experience with the ADCB app on iPhone. I am currently abroad and cannot access my account, even though online banking should be available wherever customers travel. The app either fails to load properly or restricts access outside the UAE, which is extremely inconvenient when you need to manage your finances remotely.

For an international bank serving customers who travel frequently, this limitation feels outdated and frustrating. Reliability and accessibility should be basic expectations for a banking app. I hope ADCB addresses this issue and provides a better experience for customers outside the UAE

title: Horrendous
body:
I genuinely did not think it was possible for an app update to make an experience worse than before, but this latest version has managed to do exactly that.

The previous version had genuinely useful features that made managing finances straightforward and user-friendly. Now, many of those features are either gone or buried behind a much less intuitive interface. The user experience has clearly regressed.

One of the most frustrating changes is the removal of the ability to easily hide and unhide balances — a simple but very practical feature that many users relied on for privacy and convenience.

The credit card section has also taken a major step backwards. Previously, there were clear and detailed breakdowns showing statement amounts, minimum payments, and the exact amount needed to avoid penalties or interest charges. That information was extremely useful for responsible financial management. Now, those details are either difficult to find or no longer available at all.

Overall, the app feels less functional, less user-friendly, and more frustrating to use than before. Instead of improving on what already worked well, the update seems to have removed practical features that users actually valued.
author: Muna.zw

reply.body:
Hello, we’re sorry to hear about your experience. To mask or unmask your balance, please tap the “eye” icon at the top of the home screen. Rest assured, your feedback has been shared with the concerned team for review.

title: The best bank in UAE
body:
I’ve had the best banking experience with ADCB so far. Their online banking system is extremely seamless, fast, and very user-friendly. Transactions are processed quickly, making daily banking smooth and stress-free.
What I love the most is how modern and aesthetically designed the app and services are , everything feels premium, organized, and easy to navigate. Customer service has also been professional and efficient whenever assistance was needed.

Overall, ADCB offers a secure, convenient, and excellent banking experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and hassle-free banking in the UAE.

title: Buggy, Cluttered, and Distracting
body:
The app's feature set feels bloated with unnecessary additions that detract from core functionality. I've experienced frequent service interruptions requiring repeated attempts to complete transactions, which is concerning for financial management. More problematically, the persistent prompts to enable AI features are inappropriate for a banking application—I need a finance tool focused on essentials, not experimental features.

For my needs, I require an application that prioritizes three things: speed, security, and reliability. This app doesn't deliver on those fundamentals. I'd recommend streamlining the interface, improving system stability, and removing intrusive feature recommendations.

With the new app the basic necessity of send an alert to every user on 80-90% is now not an option. I’ve to either opt in app notifications (which I tried and failed, clicking on the notification didn’t take you to the content as the app fails 100% of time to load the content on the notification, off course on top of requiring to click and face log) and worst part the notification pop up announces the balance, doesn’t help at all, unlike the old sms that didn’t !

Now we are stuck with notification that requires, logging in and failing to load content and pop up that announces everything! Or the bank makes you forget about your transaction below 500!

reply.body:
We’re sorry to hear about your experience and apologize for the inconvenience. Please note that you can still receive SMS alerts for transactions by disabling push notifications in the app settings. Regarding screenshots, they have been restricted as part of our security measures to protect customer data. We’ve also taken note of your feedback regarding the alerts page not loading correctly, and it has been shared with our teams for review.
M.I

title: ADCB New App Reliability Issues
body:
The rollout of the new ADCB app has been extremely disappointing. The application repeatedly freezes on the “Verifying Identity” stage despite multiple reinstall attempts, network changes, and various troubleshooting steps. At the same time, the legacy app has effectively been phased out, leaving customers dependent on a platform that is currently unreliable and non-functional.

The customer support experience has also been frustrating, with repetitive scripted responses and little sense of ownership or effective resolution. For a bank of this calibre, the transition appears rushed, poorly managed, and highly disruptive for customers.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption and frustration you’ve experienced, and we appreciate you taking the time to share such detailed feedback. title: New ADCB App
body:
Very disappointing update. The new ADCB app feels unfinished and overly dependent on AI features that add complexity instead of improving banking services.

Many essential banking functions are missing, harder to access, or less practical than the previous version. The app looks modern, but usability and stability have clearly declined.

Banking apps should prioritize reliability, speed, and complete services — not experimental AI prompts and flashy design. It honestly feels like the app was released before being fully ready.

ADCB should focus on restoring core banking features and improving user experience instead of forcing AI into every interaction.

title: Clear Overview, But Needs Better Tracking Features
body:
The app overall is great and easy to use. However, a few improvements would make it even more practical:

* It would be very helpful to have an option to view the total amount spent or received within a selected date range. Currently, it mainly shows individual transactions or basic summaries, but a clear “Total Amount” feature would make tracking much easier.
* It would also be great to add a search/filter option by account or beneficiary. For example, being able to quickly see how much I’ve spent on restaurants, petrol, or a specific vendor would make expense tracking much more efficient.

These features would significantly improve the user experience and financial visibility.

body:
Hi,

But all throughout the process, your agent was hard to contact, not giving updates, late process, I needed to request a liability letter 2 times on my 2banks because they didn’t finish the whole process within than 14days validity of liability letter, which causes me another payments, another days of waiting, and time to spend on processing. I am working in the hospital and it’s very hard for me to just go outside to visit the branch on requesting and collecting the letter, take off on specific days just to meet the agents. Your bank should have atleast take consideration the situation of your client. This is very stressful and disappointing.

title: Amazing bank however room for improvement!
body:
Dear ADCB Team,

I wanted to take a moment to express my appreciation for the exceptional services your bank provides. ADCB is, without a doubt, one of the best—if not the best—banks in the UAE. Your user-friendly app, outstanding customer support, and commitment to eco-friendly banking truly set you apart.

That said, I believe there are still a couple of areas where things could be even better:
	1.	PDF confirmation of transfers: It would be incredibly helpful if a PDF receipt could be generated automatically after each transfer—instantly available in the app once initiated, and optionally sent via email once completed. Importantly, this PDF should exclude any balance details for privacy.
	2.	Business accounts for virtual office holders: This is a personal request. I currently hold a business account with RAKBANK, which I opened early on when I was less experienced. Over time, I’ve held savings accounts with many leading banks in the UAE—ENBD, FAB, Mashreq, CBD, and RAKBANK—but I ultimately chose to stay with ADCB because your service quality, app functionality, and overall banking experience are far superior.

I especially appreciate the simplicity and eco-conscious design, the seamless access to e-statements, IBAN sharing, and even the ability to generate custom e-statements. All of these features have solved issues I encountered with other banks.

Now, I am eager to move my business banking to ADCB as well. However, I’ve noticed that there currently isn’t a business account offering for virtual office setups. I would sincerely appreciate it if ADCB could consider introducing such an option, as I would be honored to become a business client in addition to a personal one.

Thank you once again for your continued excellence.

Warm regards,
author: Manav Mahendru

reply.body:

body:
The ADCB app is so worst that it takes more than 5 mins to login. Repeatedly gives error unable to serve your request. Your session has timed out etc. After trying for 5 mins then it logs you in once. Also the banking service is bad. Local transfers take painfully long. Also they had blocked my credit cards and even after expiry they haves sent me the renewed cards. The debit card is also expired and I haven’t received the renewed card.
I have decided to close my account with them. I will not recommend ADCB to anyone. Stay away from this bank. All other banks complete local payments in few minutes. It has been more than 12 hours now and the status of my local payment transfer still shows are in progress. While my transfers thru other banks like FAB Citi WIO takes not more than few minutes. I recommend to stay away from ADCB.

title: Disappointing Change - Minimum Balance Requirement
body:
I recently opened a zero-balance account through the ADCB bank app, attracted by the promise of no minimum balance requirements. However, I was surprised when ADCB suddenly imposed a minimum balance requirement of AED 3,000.

This change is inconvenient and costly for customers like me who initially chose the zero-balance option. It contradicts the bank's initial promise and creates unnecessary financial burdens.

Suggestions for improvement:

1. Honor the initial zero-balance promise or provide adequate notice for changes.
2. Consider waiving minimum balance requirements for certain account types.
3. Enhance transparency regarding account terms and conditions.

Overall, this change has diminished my satisfaction with ADCB. I hope the bank reconsiders its policies to better serve customers.
author: thariq anjarakandy

title: ADCB Credit Card Scam – Beware!
body:
I’ve had a frustrating experience with ADCB’s credit card. I missed the full payment for one month, but I made the minimum payment. The next month, the bank charged me a finance fee of 870 AED. The following month, I paid the full outstanding amount before the due date, but they still charged me 359 AED in finance fees.

Despite sending multiple emails to their customer service, the issue remains unresolved. Over time, I’ve lost nearly 1,200 AED due to these unjust charges.

To anyone considering applying for an ADCB credit card, think twice! This bank is not transparent with their finance charges, and it’s been an incredibly stressful experience trying to resolve this.

Please be cautious and consider other options before getting involved with ADCB!

title: Bad UX/UI
body:
The mobile banking application I've used is the worst ever.

To send money, you must laboriously add a beneficiary with extensive details, and even after that, there's no direct way to send funds.

You're forced to navigate back through slow data fetching, locate the person again, and fill in numerous fields repeatedly.

Additionally, face checking is always required, making it inconvenient if you're without proper lighting.

The UI resembles something from the 90s, and the app operates sluggishly.

Transaction history is severely lacking, with only a few recent transactions available. The transaction filter has been non-functional for the past six months.

title: Insane
body: I have had 5 bank accounts in my life. This one has been the worst and most problematic user experience I could have imagined and I greatly regret opening an account with ADCB. The app has been riddled with bugs since the moment I installed it. First, broken login. Next, I’m unable to add payees. After that, payee takes 6 hours to confirm. Finally, after payee is finally confirmed, the app blocks me from making any payments. I called customer support and account manager multiple times, and I visited the branch twice asking for help. No one could fix the problem. In order to make vital payments on time I was forced to spend hours out of each day visiting a branch and filing payments at the tiller - a minimum of an extra 2 hours per payment. This took over 1.5 weeks to resolve. Finally, I was contacted by phone to confirm a payee who was confirmed in the system over a week ago before I could finally make payments. Completely unacceptable for a bank, upon whom people depend for their livelihood and punctual payments, to be so incompetent and inefficient.

وضع الوجه في الاطار عند التحويل هذا افشل ابديت شفته في تطبيق البنك سلبياته اكثر غن ايجابياته 
1. التحويل امام الناس و انا اعمل هالحركات بوجهي 
2. اوقات اعطي لعيالي يحولون لي و لازم وجهي يكون في الاطار 
3. حاطه ماسك على وجهي 
و إلى آخره. 
بعض الحالات الاستثنائية 
خلوه مثل ما كان او طوروها للافضل مو للاسوء 
ابتكار فاشل 
يعني مو كفاية وضع الرقم التعريف الشخصي للمرحلة الاخيرة للتحويل 
او رقم السري للهاتف 
او حتى التعرف ع الوجه حق التلفون 
او ارسال كود بالمسج 

ياليت وضع خيايرين للتحويل في ناس ماتعجبهم هالوجه اللي شرات القرد تحركه في الاطار 
و انا اولهم

title: Disappointing Banking Experience: Credit Card Woes and Poor Customer Service
body: Sorry for saying that recently had an extremely frustrating experience with ADCB, which left me thoroughly disappointed with their services. The primary issue revolved around my credit card, which consistently failed to work despite my numerous attempts to resolve the problem. As a result, I found myself in a troubling situation, unable to make essential purchases or access funds when I needed them the most. First and foremost, the lack of responsiveness from ADCB's customer service team was utterly disheartening. I made several attempts to contact them, spending hours on hold and being transferred from one representative to another, only to receive vague and unhelpful responses. It seemed as though the representatives lacked both the knowledge and the willingness to assist me effectively. This poor level of customer support only added to my mounting frustration. To make matters worse, the credit card issues persisted for an extended period. I experienced embarrassing moments at various stores and restaurants when my card was declined, despite having ample credit available. It was both inconvenient and embarrassing to be caught in such situations, especially when I had confirmed with the bank that there were no issues with my account. Moreover, the lack of proactive communication from ADCB was particularly aggravating. I expected the bank to inform me about any technical glitches or outages that could impact their services, especially regarding credit cards. Unfortunately, I had to discover the problem on my own and continuously reach out to the bank, only to be met with unsatisfactory resolutions. As a loyal customer who has maintained an account with ABCB for several years, I had higher expectations for their service quality. Regrettably, my experience has proven otherwise. The persistent credit card malfunctions and the abysmal customer service have eroded my trust in the bank's ability to address customer needs promptly and efficiently. I strongly urge ADCB to reevaluate its customer service practices and invest in improving its technical infrastructure. Customers should not have to endure such inconveniences and frustrations, particularly when they rely on their banking services for daily transactions and financial stability. In conclusion, my recent encounters with ADCB have been deeply disappointing. The consistent credit card issues coupled with the unresponsive customer service have left me with a bitter taste. I am currently exploring alternative banking options to ensure that I do not have to endure such a dreadful experience again.

title: Definitely one of the worst bank apps
body:
This app is so awful I actually switched banks to get away from it. Transactions are frequently not sorted in the right order. No details are provided when you select a specific transaction. The balance doesn’t match the real balance, and can be different based on which page you are on. The credit card history is a mess. I was viewing transactions in April but it decided to show my February’s transactions instead. No information is provided on how to use the touch points. The privacy mode just hides the balance in one place, and is useless other than that. I can go on and on… hope to see a much more refined product from ADCB in the future.

It’s 2023. We should all expect better.

title: Fraudulent Bank!!
body:
They will tell you LIES to get you to apply for a credit card and overcharge you for everything! 
And customer service is absolutely useless and would call you a million times to make you do services that you don’t want!

A representative from the bank called me to sell me getting a new credit card which I told her I’m not interested since I already have one, she kept insisting and told me I can use it to pay for my new car’s downpayment. I asked her if I can split it into equal payments over 2 years interest free as other banks have this option, she confirmed several times that it is an option.

I asked her if she is sure if it’s interest free she confirmed again and she said you will only pay 50 dirhams processing fee, and she went back to her manager to confirm with him then she called me back and said he also confirmed that this was an option.

I proceeded with the application based on her confirmation, and when Ireceived the credit card a guy called me to convince me to take cash loan  vs the limist and I told him O’m not interested in this option, and he kept convincing me and nagging in an annoying manner to take the cash loan! And told me intereste free payment was not an option for my card. I told him if it’s not an option I will cancel the credit card because it’s the only reason I did it and I don’t need it for any other purposee. Another guy called me back and he confirmed once again that I have the option of interest free hut over 2 year only and the processing fee is 50 dirhams, I told him it was still fine.

After paying the down payment for my car, I called the customer service to sdo the split payment, he told me there’s a processimg fee of 700 dirhams!! Because the seller is not one of the customers that are a part of this offer! Which no one cared to mention before! Hi, ADCB is part of Central Bank Immediate Payment Instruction (IPI), hence, all domestic transfers are credited instantly to beneficiary bank if they are also registered for the same service regardless if it is a weekend or a public holiday. So i left with an request form and downloaded the mobile app and still there is nooooooo where that I can see how to request a check book. On my online banking I still can’t seem to find the tab that requests the cheque book. This really frustrates me as I spent half of my off time to still have no cheque book requested. Shocking honestly as ENBD has that feature inside their app that I can order my chequebook.

title: Too much problem!
body:
I am new to this apps and this bank, and yet problem is already there! 
My friend encourage me to open up an account to this bank bcoz they said no minimum balance required and no charge even u have zero balance.
But sending money is the problem to this account!
I try to send money outside uae, there no other option but only their own option which 2-5 working days, and has 105aed charge which is too much! 
And they didn’t mention on the apps that 2-5 working days the weekends are not included!
And after 5days my money just came back to my acct and it’s less than i send. 
I call their customer care but they say i need to wait again 3 working day for them to let me know why it didn’t when through and got back to my acct. like what the...! My family needs the money so im sending them and i use this bank and apps to less hussle! But it turns out too much hussle for me and now almost 7days included weekends and i need to wait more 3days to know the reason why?! 
And IT IS NOT EVEN SURE IF THEY WILL GONNA GIVE BACK MY MONEY! OMG! 
IM TOO MUCH DISAPPOINTED!

title: NO NOTIFICATION!!!!!
body:
Don’t sign up with ADCB if you want to experience bad customer service. I am getting no notification for point of sale transactions since MARCH and they said we stopped sending alert. They asked me to wait for 2-3 days until I can see them on my mobile app. I won’t receive SMS either for any of the transactions either. 

Who will remember transaction amount for 2-3 days and keep track of it if you were charged correctly or not? 

It’s completely useless and I plan to move to a different bank very soon. Disappointed.
author: AteamSF

reply.body:
Hi, SMS's are no longer sent for transactions that are less than AED 100; this does not apply for online purchases, you will continue to receive an SMS for online purchases regardless of the amount. For more info on this, please call 600 502030.

title: Good application but
body:
I like the interface , it fulfills most if not all of my banking needs , it became a bit slower after the last major upgrade as after each touch you will need to wait couple of second till it loads .

I like the credit card controls , very effective and easy to use .

But , the app shows the last page contents when using the app switcher , not very smart especially if you are trying to keep your data private, other banking apps easily would hide that out until you reopen the application .

Touch points details doesn’t give much other than the total points you have , I would think adding more into the dashboard will be great , like last transaction and how much it earned you, or bonus points you were able to acquire ... etc

I don’t normally write app reviews, but my experience with ADCB app has been horrible and so has been with customer service trying to solve the issue. I have not been able to access my account on the app for months.  And no solution offered by the bank has helped, whether resetting the pin, or trying to login online or anything they’ve suggested. From experience in the past, sometimes you cannot have more than two devices linked per app for the same account, and even that they did not know if they had such a limit. I’ve deleted and installed the app many times with no luck. I call they say email, I email they say call the customer service number. Horrible experience and no solution regardless of all tries. I change the password, my name shows as a customer before login and still can’t login to access the account and says to call customer service. 

Horrible app!

title: Still a slow & sluggish app
body:
Feb 2019:
Another update but once again no speed improvement and now includes some new functionality & design features that HAVE NOT been thought out properly!

New functionality is the Card Control settings. Very good!

However, the poorly thought out design is that the Card Control feature seems to always be open by default, with the first option within those settings to be “Temporary Block”.

When going to close the Card Control area the close button is right above the “Temporary Block” toggle which is annoying to accidentally invoke a “temporary block” each time you close the Card Control options.

Still no inclusion of the Touchpoints Account.

 

Jan 2019:

Im sure some effort has gone into trying to speed up this app, but it is still frustratingly slow, and sluggish.

UNABLE to use the “TouchPoints” account for payments just adds more frustration and dissatisfaction.

I’ll wait for one more incremental upgrade and if the speed issues and Touchpoints are not addressed, then its time to move to a new Bank. There are significantly better offerings in the market right now!
Even a one star is one too many for this app.
A big 👎🏻

title: Absolutely disaster update
body:
I need the previous version back asap. This version is not only buggy and complex but absolutely horrible and unsafe. Here are the issues:

1. It displays total value of your cash and deposits in the main screen in big font, an absolute privacy and security risk if you are opening the app outside your home or in front of your friend. The previous version did no display the balance till you tap on account on fixed deposit. I open the app in restaurants, shopping places to see latest credit card transaction, credit card limit is exceeded or not, or if the current account has sufficient funds for the incoming cheque. 

2. Now it is difficult to even navigate to your accounts or make money transfer. Money transfer within adcb accounts has been made unnecessarily complex, requiring many more taps, and non intuitive UI, small fonts where you are unable to clearly see the From/to accounts, exchange rate, balance before or after transfer in accounts, blah blah. Previous version had text fonts bigger enough for clarity, even though the version appeared less polished.

3. Scrolling and swiping is buggy, lot of times it hangs when you swipe or scroll. Wonder why these people don’t pre-populate the data before user begins scrolling?

Overall, the previous version was a usable and stable app that initially appeared less polished but worked amazing for all your needs. If any polishing was needed, one could simply polish the previous app while preserving the flow and UI. The current “polished” update is buggy and unusable for my needs.

title: When modern is worse than classic
body:
The previous version of the app was not sophisticated visually, but was very reliable and easy to use for most operations.
This new Nov 2018 version tries to modernise the look of the app, but has lots of bugs and complicates the user navigation with lots of scrolling and drop downs. It’s a pure example of form over function.
To make a transfer, takes me 2-3 attempts: first app crashes, then need to wait because there is an active session, repeat attempt, wait, repeat...
Word of advice: don’t release a buggy version just because there is a schedule to meet. In other banks this would be enough go back to the previous version until bugs are sorted.
Bottom line after more than one week having this buggy version live is for users to not upgrade, or dear ADCB, step up and issue a revised version with bugs addressed. If not possible, revert to previous version in the meantime.
1 star rating for this updated version as it stands.

body:

It's been more than a year since Apple introduced the tall, notched displays in their X series phones and the app has still not been updated to support such displays. The UI experience is so bad that you don't feel like using the app at all. While the apps of many competitor banks have been updated to be modern and responsive, the ADCB app still feels about a decade old. Time to catch UP ADCB! 

Oh, one more thing! When do you plan to add support for Apple Pay?

Usability is ok, but it needs an update. Urgently.

title: Useless Services, Ridiculous System
body:
The process of beneficiaries verification with this bank is totally inconvenient & ridiculous, I needed add a beneficiary to make an urgent transfer and the app said it takes 2 working days until some “human” manually verifies the details, this doesn’t make any sense, the entire purpose of creating smart apps is to make life easier without human interaction, furthermore, I wasted 30 minutes trying to reach a call center agent who provided me with a useless answer advising me to visit the branch!!

Try to learn from Dubai Islamic Bank, verifying a new beneficiary can be done via receiving an OTP, end of story!!!

Ridiculous customer service.
